cursor.note: KICK-BACK TO BUILDME — the chart is not answered, so this node does not rest. The code is built and green under a confirmed netns seal and the watch is armed and crossed; what refuses PROVED is the VERDICT, and it refuses honestly. Of the validate berth's eight criteria, three pass (the three rungs proved off-box under injected roots with the real home never read and the temp tree empty after; the teeth shown to GRIP by a seeded hollow resolver, red at the tooth that names the reason; the charter delta with the lab copy identical after the gate was poked in the same act) and five fail. THE FIVE, AND WHAT KIND OF FAILURE EACH IS. (3) The one-table criterion's fourth instrument clause — 'no cairn.* import under cairn/tools/base outside {cairn.tools.base.*, cairn.tools.charter.projector}' — cannot run: deviceness.py reaches cairn.devices.ground_loop.discovery and transitions.py reaches five components, identically at HEAD. That is a FALSE PREMISE INHERITED FROM THE CAST, which asserted the subset from a measure it never ran over the whole package. The three substantive clauses all pass, and stronger than written: counters._ROOTS IS address.ROOTS, object identity rather than equality. (4) Two import allowlists were widened to admit cairn.tools.base.address, each with a dated comment naming this ticket per the corpus precedent — but the criterion says 'with no assertion edited', and a data tuple inside a proof is an assertion's vocabulary. A REAL DEVIATION, reported rather than absorbed. (5) The floor is 2, not 1: build_inspector/inspector.py:216 was censused at cast and dropped at decompose with no gate noticing, and it needs a rung the ladder does not have — a DEVICE ACROSS INSTANCES. (6) The probe's claim predicted that same floor of 1; the mechanism is confirmed in every other respect. (8) Not runnable — its instrument reads the CLOSED ticket and this voyage does not close. WHAT THE KICK-BACK IS ASKING FOR, and why it is not more building on my own authority: three of the five are the CHART being wrong rather than the BUILD, and I did not retune a single criterion — a falsifier edited to match what happened cannot report that anything happened. The remaining work needs bounds only Akien sets: whether the two allowlist widenings stand, and whether the eighth site earns a fourth rung (device-across-instances) or stays hand-spelled with a named disposition. The verdict artifact that states all of this is DRAFTED AND CANNOT BE BERTHED: cairn.machines.chart.verdict has exactly one exit, so a kick-back leaves no durable artifact through that door and this record is the only place it lives. That is itself a finding about the chart chain, and it is the second one this voyage produced — the first being that a piece's file list is prose no gate checks against the survey berth.

window.emission_gate: clean — WATCHME(device-claims-match-shims) emitted the probe berthed at cairn/tools/base/probes/device_claims_match_shims.py (ticket 'device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim')
window.note: DEVICE-NESS IS A FUNCTION NOW, AND THE DIVERGENCE IT EXPOSES IS ON THE WIRE. is_device() answers once for everyone, composing ground_loop.discovery rather than re-deriving it, and it admits the Calibre shape — a folder with a probes/ directory, no class, no import — which the inheritance axis was structurally blind to. Measured: 12 ruled devices, 11 of them subclassing nothing, 8 subclassing BaseDevice and off the roster the beat reads, symmetric difference 19 of a 20-member union, exactly one component (librarian) on all three axes. THE MECHANISM WAS NEVER WHAT WAS MISSING — Akien's folder ruling shipped in 2081efa before this voyage started, and the falsifier was already satisfied eleven times over by code on disk. What was missing was loudness. WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DECIDE: which axis WINS — sibling ticket runtime-role-is-a-second-axis at Akien's signature gate, and it is this watch's stopping condition. The chart's bounds put naming the axis OUT, so the probe stands rather than dispositioning 19 components on its own authority (Law 6). THREE DEFECTS FOUND IN THE CAST AND FIXED AT THE BUILD, each recorded on the ticket with the superseded words kept: (1) the shim count was a FILENAME census standing in for a CLASS census — 4 and 5, not 3 and 6; (2) the enough-condition was UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION and contradicted its own consumer clause in the same block; (3) the watchme trigger named a recompile_gate.sh poke while what was built rides the heartbeat — no new firing path, which was the cast's reason, but the heartbeat is a clock and the cast said 'no clock', so the cost is stated not glossed. THE LIVE FIRE FALSIFIED MY OWN RECORD: the probe's docstring claimed nothing pulses this shim, inherited from a trouble rather than measured. The spine is running — pid 109150, 1402 beats — and the probe poked on its own at 14:20:07, envelope a813b9fd37964d42a99bd93321c22a4a. The trouble the-runtime-spine-has-never-run is STALE at finding 1, retired 2026-08-09 by ground_loop/__main__.py and never re-measured; it stands open for Akien, unedited by me. TWO FIELDS FILLED AT THIS DOOR BECAUSE IT REFUSED WITHOUT THEM, both one-line and both argued rather than guessed: the ticket's owning_intention (cairn/tools/base, where every crossing on this ticket is journaled — Law 5) and base's charter gated_by ['Akien','CC'], derived from its own owner prose.

window.entry_gate: clean — a berthed chart chain claims ticket 'one-owner-for-the-instance-address', and the ticket names its /intent firing and its /sorted door firing
window.note: The instance-address ticket opens, journaled at BASE because base is where the address acquires its owner: three of base's own modules (probe.py:36, device.py:51, diagnostic.py:33) describe ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<n>/ in prose while computing it nowhere, and the rungs land here. CARRYING TWO CORRECTIONS INTO THE BUILD, both found by the chart rather than at the cast. (1) The cast called cairn/devices/inference_domain/route.py an off-ladder stray owing a disposition; the survey found it is the address a PROVED ticket chose deliberately — the-inference-proxy-is-a-rules-stack, closed 2026-08-08, whose intention says 'machine facts in ~/.cairn/inference/' verbatim, four days before the four-rung ruling existed. So child (c) is a disagreement between two rulings and the resolution is Akien's, not a stage's; converting it in passing would have silently overwritten a proved decision. (2) The constrain stage's sharpest unknown — rooted-token form versus device+instance argument form — is settled by MEASUREMENT rather than by choice: of the five 'address' values authored across every charter in the system, two are instance-space device paths written in the token form ('instance/devices/chart/0/packets', 'instance/devices/skill_block/0/berths/intent'). They are the charter-author face and the code face of ONE table, and their agreement becomes a proof tooth rather than a convention. WHAT THIS VOYAGE DOES NOT DELIVER, said at the opening so a PROVED cursor cannot be read as more: nothing will refuse an eleventh hand-spelled path. That is child (b), it is not cast, and until it lands this is a convenience under Law 4 rather than physics.

window.workflow: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> [PROVEME:waiting] -> WATCHME(hand-spelled-instance-paths) -> PROVED
window.note: PROVEME. Built the seven pieces in the berthed triage order. cairn/tools/base/address.py holds the lowered root table plus instance_path/tool_path/machine_path — resolve-only, never provisions, no position on what is a device; measured import_map ['__future__','pathlib'], which is what makes it a legal floor for callers whose proofs pin an allowlist. counters.py re-exports resolve/Unreadable so the class identity stays single and test_skilldial.py passes unedited (59 teeth, output byte-identical against a clean HEAD worktree). Seven sites converted; every before/after resolved value IDENTICAL, and the learning_block device and its own probe now share one expression — the n=1 drift the ticket was cast on is closed. TWO THINGS THE CHART DID NOT PREDICT, recorded rather than absorbed. (1) Two import allowlists had to admit cairn.tools.base.address — librarian/proofs/test_librarian_library.py and chart/proofs/test_chart_orient.py — each widened WITH a dated comment naming this ticket and the measurement, per the precedent every prior widening in the corpus followed. That is an assertion-adjacent edit and validate criterion 4 says 'with no assertion edited', so it goes to the verdict as a deviation, not as housekeeping. (2) THE FLOOR IS 2, NOT 1. The ticket's falsifier measure (b) predicted the scan would return the resolver plus the dispositioned inference_domain site alone. Measured: cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:216 as well. It was in the cast's census of ten and was dropped from the conversion piece at decompose, silently, because a piece's file list is prose and no gate checks it against the survey berth. It stays unconverted for two independent reasons: it addresses a DEVICE ACROSS INSTANCES (devices/chart, no instance segment), a shape none of the three rungs built here fits; and its allowlist is ALREADY RED on an undecided entry (the live cairn.tools.base.nest trouble), so admitting a second module there would bury one undecided admission under another. The criterion was NOT retuned to match what happened — a falsifier tuned to the outcome cannot report an outcome. Corpus: 98 proofs, 96 green, 2 red, and BOTH reds reproduce at HEAD dc71f1c in a clean worktree — this build introduced none.

window.build_gate: clean — build_inspector ran 19 sieves over base
window.note: WATCHME(hand-spelled-instance-paths). The probe is armed at the berth the ticket named, cairn/tools/base/probes/hand_spelled_instance_paths.py — a module-level frozen Probe carrying both carry and enough, berthed with WHAT IT WATCHES (the resolver) rather than with the ticket it was compiled from. Fired live three ways: at the floor it reports 2 sites and NAMES both with 119 files scanned; seeded with a fake hand-spelling it reports 3 and names the new one; and a scan that reads zero files FIRES rather than clears, carrying 'the scan read NO FILES — the count is not a measurement', because a zero over an unwalked tree is the vacuous green this watch was written against. THE FIRST LIVE FIRE CAUGHT ITS BUILDER, as first live fires keep doing: the probe counted ITSELF — line 146, the sentence in its own prose describing the pattern it hunts. That is the sibling probe's lesson in a new costume (does_optional_mean_never_carried counted its own owning ticket), so the exclusion is now explicit and commented with the why. Caught at n=1, by firing it. THE FLOOR IS NAMED, NOT TOLERATED: the enough clause compares the site FILES against a named pair, so converting one of the two while a third appears cannot read as 'expected'. The floor recorded here is 2, not the 1 the ticket predicted — the criterion was not retuned to match. The probe carries no authority: it deposits and pokes, and the eleventh hand-spelled path is a spec-level fact for Akien's gate (Law 6).
